description: WP-O5 Codex: Orks (11e) TARGETIN' SQUIGS (Shoota Boyz enhancement; add 3" to the Range characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit, excluding [TORRENT]) — passive. Fixture ork11e_enh_shoota_boyz: the Warboss (Kustom shoota 18") stands ~20.4" from Custodian Guard B. The shooting panel assigns the 18" guns to them (range rings drawn at +3"), and only the [TORRENT] Skorcha is reported out of range; a real click on Confirm shoots: the four 18" weapons resolve against the unit 20.4" away (Game Log), the Skorcha does not. Setup privilege: auto wound allocation.

steps.script:
SettingsService.set("auto_allocate_wounds", true)
return true

var d = load("res://scripts/codex/orks/OrkAbilities11e.gd").dist_in("U_WARBOSS_A", "U_CUSTODIAN_GUARD_B")
return d > 18.0 and d < 21.0
steps.comment: Custodian Guard B are ~20.4" from the Warboss — beyond its 18" Kustom shoota, within 18 + 3

steps.script: return load("res://autoloads/RulesEngine.gd").ork11e_det_range_bonus(GameState.get_unit("U_WARBOSS_A"), {"name": "Kustom shoota", "type": "Ranged", "range": 18, "special_rules": ""})
steps.comment: Targetin' Squigs: +3" Range for this unit's ranged (non-Torrent) weapons
the shooting panel lists the 18" Kustom shoota against the unit 20.4" away (Current Targets)
the [TORRENT] Skorcha gets no bonus: 'only 0 of 1 will shoot — out of range'

steps.script: ScenarioRunner.event_log_count_containing("Custodian Guard Sodality with Kustom shoota (weapon 4/4)")
steps.comment: the 18" Kustom shoota shot the unit 20.4" away (Game Log: Warboss -> Custodian Guard Sodality with Kustom shoota, hit dice rolled)

steps.script: ScenarioRunner.event_log_count_containing("Kombi-skorcha - Skorcha") + ScenarioRunner.event_log_count_containing("Kombi-skorcha – Skorcha")
steps.comment: the [TORRENT] Skorcha did not shoot (out of range)
